proves.claim: with review.relaxRequiredFamily on, an item filed with --review-family and no live eligible seat of that family for 20 minutes is offered by the real next --verify to a seat of another session, and the real verify records that the required family was widened and why.

cli.journeys-show-review-tier.review-fam.why: The widening of a required review family is built from three units; without a journey through the real CLI they could each pass while next and verify never widen an item.
